name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Code mods that add information and safeguards above and below the prompt: risky-action cards, done alerts, a repo and usage bar, check results in the status line, and cross-session task progress.

plugins.name: danger-guard
plugins.description: Asks on a card before risky actions: lists what a delete would remove and moves it to the Trash by default, shows what git reset, clean, force push and branch -D would lose, and asks before editing files outside the project

plugins.name: done-alert
plugins.description: When a long turn ends, shows a green notice above the prompt (red on errors), rings while the app is in front and leaves the rest to its own notifications; sends a notification in the terminal

plugins.name: repo-bar
plugins.description: Shows the repo, branch and owner above the prompt, plus session cost, last-turn cost, plan quotas and context usage

plugins.name: run-status
plugins.description: Shows in the status line under the prompt whether tests, builds and type checks passed or failed

plugins.name: task-progress
plugins.description: Lists every session's running task above the prompt with a progress bar, percent and time left (from per-step estimates when the task list gives them, with an over-estimate warning and a note for when you're needed); finished tasks turn green, and clicking a name jumps to that session
